subject: english
question:
Four words of the following sentence have been underlined and given as options. Select the option that contains a spelling error.

Ozone is a __reactiev__ gas that is not only important in protecting us from harmful ultraviolet __radiation__ but is also a greenhouse gas and, at high smog-level __concentrations__, harmful to human health and __vegetation__.
solution:
The incorrect spelling is: **reactiev**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"reactiev"** is a misspelling of the word **"reactive,"** which means tending to react quickly and strongly to something. (प्रतिक्रियाशील)

 
 
• **Example: **The substance is highly reactive and should be handled with care.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1 i.e. reactiev**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Radiation **(रेडिएशन): The emission of energy as electromagnetic waves or as moving subatomic particles.

 
 
• **Example:** The radiation from the sun is essential for life on Earth.
 
 
 
• **Concentrations **(सांद्रता): The abundance of a constituent divided by the total volume of a mixture.
 
 
• **Example: **The concentrations of pollutants in the air have reached alarming levels.
 
 
 
• **Vegetation** (वनस्पति): Plants considered collectively, especially those found in a particular area or habitat.
 
 
• **Example:** The dense vegetation of the rainforest is home to a wide variety of wildlife.
